title.zh: 将北阿古桑 Las Nieves 的 Las Nieves 国立中学－Mat-I 附属校从该校分离，改设为名为 Mat-I 国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Las Nieves National High School - Mat-I Annex From the Las Nieves National High School in Las Nieves, Agusan Del Norte and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Mat-I National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Mat-I của Trường Trung học Las Nieves Quốc gia khỏi Trường Trung học Las Nieves Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Mat-I Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Mat-I ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Las Nieves แห่งชาติออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Las Nieves แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mat-I แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Mat-I, Sekolah Menengah Las Nieves Nasional dari Sekolah Menengah Las Nieves Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mat-I Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Mat-I, Sekolah Menengah Las Nieves Kebangsaan daripada Sekolah Menengah Las Nieves Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mat-I Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Las Nieves National High School - Mat-I Annex is hereby separated from the Las Nieves National High School in Las Nieves, Agusan del Norte and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Mat-I National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Las Nieves National High School - Mat-I Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Mat-I National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
